narrative.details:
I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard.  Bring it to him.

And if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way.  Or fall to an enemy.
narrative.objectives: Bring Neeka's Report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. From Neeka's report, I see the Alliance is not without its own problems. And we may find that some enemies are shared between us.
narrative.requestItemsText: You returned. You have a report?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 35 to 40, 3,700 XP in all.
